blocks.prompt: 14 (a) [printed as 13 (a)] If the demand function for a particular commodity is \(p = 100 - 2x\) and the market price is \(p_e = \text{Rs. } 64\), find the consumer's surplus using two methods: Integrate with respect to \(x\).
blocks.explanation:
Pehle woh quantity \(x_e\) nikalni hai jo market price par khareedi jati hai.
Phir \(0\) se \(x_e\) tak (demand minus price) ka integral, bilkul Example 61 ke method (i) ki tarah.
Plan: \(x_e\), phir \(x\) ke lehaaz se integral.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(D(x) = 100 - 2x\), \(p_e = 64\).
Maloom karna: \(x\) ke lehaaz se integrate kar ke CS.
Tareeqa: \(CS = \int_0^{x_e}(D(x) - p_e)\,dx\). Integrand woh izafi raqam hai jo consumer dene ko tayyar tha lekin dena nahi pari.

Qadam 1: Equilibrium quantity
\[100 - 2x_e = 64 \Rightarrow x_e = 18\]
Kyun: Market price par demand curve batati hai ke kitni quantity khareedi jayegi: \(2x_e = 36\).

Qadam 2: Integrate karein
\[CS = \int_0^{18}(100 - 2x - 64)\,dx = \int_0^{18}(36 - 2x)\,dx\]
\[= \left[36x - x^{2}\right]_0^{18} = 648 - 324 = 324\]
Kyun: Pehle \(100 - 64 = 36\) simplify kiya, phir power rule. \(18^{2} = 324\) aur \(36 \times 18 = 648\).
Dhyan dein: Upper limit \(x_e = 18\) hai, \(p_e = 64\) nahi; \(x\) ke integral mein limits quantities hoti hain.

Tasdeeq:
Triangle: base 18, height \(100 - 64 = 36\): \(\frac{1}{2}\cdot 18\cdot 36 = 324\). Wohi jawab.

blocks.prompt: 14 (b) [printed as 13 (b)] If the demand function for a particular commodity is \(p = 100 - 2x\) and the market price is \(p_e = \text{Rs. } 64\), find the consumer's surplus using two methods: Integrate with respect to \(p\).
blocks.explanation:
Ab price wale axis ke saath integrate karna hai.
Demand ko \(x_d(p)\) ki shakal mein likhenge aur \(p_e\) se choke price \(p_{\max} = D(0)\) tak integral lenge (3.7.2, "With respect to price").
Choke price (gala ghontne wali price) woh price hai jis par demand bilkul zero ho jati hai.
Plan: \(x\) ko \(p\) mein likhna, \(p_{\max}\), phir integral.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(p = 100 - 2x\), \(p_e = 64\).
Maloom karna: \(p\) ke lehaaz se integrate kar ke CS.
Tareeqa: \(CS = \int_{p_e}^{p_{\max}} x_d(p)\,dp\), yani horizontal strips ka jama.

Qadam 1: Demand \(p\) ke function ke taur par, aur choke price
\[x_d(p) = \dfrac{100 - p}{2}\]
\[p_{\max} = D(0) = 100\]
Kyun: \(p = 100 - 2x\) ko \(x\) ke liye hal kiya: \(2x = 100 - p\). Choke price woh hai jahan \(x = 0\), yani \(p = 100\).

Qadam 2: Integrate karein
\[CS = \int_{64}^{100}\dfrac{100 - p}{2}\,dp = \dfrac{1}{2}\left[100p - \dfrac{p^{2}}{2}\right]_{64}^{100}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\left[(10000 - 5000) - (6400 - 2048)\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}(5000 - 4352) = 324\]
Kyun: \(p = 64\) se \(p = 100\) tak har horizontal strip ki lambai \(x_d(p)\) hai. \(\frac{64^{2}}{2} = \frac{4096}{2} = 2048\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan limits prices hain (64 se 100), quantities nahi.

Tasdeeq:
Part (a) wala hi jawab: Rs. 324. Dono tareeqe ek hi triangle ko naap rahe hain, ek vertical strips se aur ek horizontal strips se.
